rules.scope: one unmodified C/C++ function; strict parse and scope-resolved local/parameter bindings
rules.guards: enclosing if/for/while branch, or same-block prior if with unconditional return/throw; shared bound value required
rules.definitions: latest enclosing lexical definition; reject intervening assignment, update, address escape, goto/label/case; not a CFG dominance proof
rules.fields: exact access path, never all fields sharing an object; intervening calls invalidate field-state checks
rules.memory: memcpy/memmove/memset/strncpy with destination array/allocation definition and explicit length argument
rules.capacity: all nested array dimensions, in elements; sizeof(array) in bytes; symbolic lengths stay unknown
rules.resources: malloc/calloc/realloc definition to free/fclose/close; or same-block free/release to dereference, with no intervening write/goto
rules.unknown: no alias, global binding, macro recovery, type-width proof, call summary, CFG/DDG/CDG or vulnerability verdict
rules.lines: zero-based physical lines and UTF-8 byte offsets; presentation may use one-based lines

stage_order: Train mining and source review before fixed-rule Valid; no Test read
localizer_reference: existing full 512 LOSVER, positive threshold >0.5; no inference rerun
ast_difference: multiset of atomic AST units and non-comment tokens; unique remaining callee matches for argument edits; not optimal tree-edit or semantic equivalence
